lean.statement:
theorem result
    {E H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (F : E → H) (D : E → E →L[ℝ] H)
    (hF : ∀ w, HasFDerivAt F (D w) w)
    (M₁ M₂ : ℝ) (hM₁ : 0 ≤ M₁) (hM₂ : 0 ≤ M₂)
    (hBound : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ‖D w‖ ≤ M₁)
    (hLip : ∀ w u : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ‖D w-D u‖ ≤ M₂*‖w-u‖) :
    let V : H → E → ℝ := fun r w => 2 * ⟪r,F w⟫_ℝ
    let G : H → E → E := fun r w =>
      (2 : ℝ) • ((D w).adjoint r - ⟪(D w).adjoint r,w⟫_ℝ • w)
    (∀ r w, HasFDerivAt (V r) ((2 : ℝ) • innerSL ℝ ((D w).adjoint r)) w) ∧
    (∀ r w, ‖w‖ = 1 →
      ⟪w,G r w⟫_ℝ = 0 ∧
      (∀ v, ⟪w,v⟫_ℝ = 0 → ⟪G r w,v⟫_ℝ = 2 * ⟪r,D w v⟫_ℝ) ∧
      ‖G r w‖ ≤ 2 * M₁ * ‖r‖) ∧
    ∀ r q w u, ‖w‖ = 1 → ‖u‖ = 1 →
      ‖G r w-G q u‖ ≤ 2 * M₁ * ‖r-q‖ +
        2 * (M₂+2*M₁) * ‖q‖ * ‖w-u‖
approved_definition_context: The displayed E and H are actual complete real inner-product normed spaces. Every norm on a vector is its Hilbert norm; a norm on a continuous linear map is the operator norm. E →L[ℝ] H is the actual normed space of continuous real linear maps.

For an actual continuous real linear map A, A.adjoint is the Hilbert adjoint, characterized by inner(A.adjoint r,v)=inner(r,A v). innerSL ℝ z is the continuous linear functional v ↦ inner(z,v). Scalar multiplication and subtraction are literal vector and operator operations.

HasFDerivAt F A w states full ambient Frechet differentiability: the norm of F(w+h)-F(w)-A(h), divided by norm(h), tends to zero as h tends to zero. All displayed unit and closed-ball conditions use the ambient Hilbert norm.
